model.stay: upstream proxy K_A; fixed registry cash charge R_A
model.switch: upstream proxy K_B includes first-request lost cache; fixed registry cash charge R_A + D
model.threshold: alpha >= 1 - (K_B-K_A)/D for an individual cost-increasing alternative, D>0
model.pass_through: customer cost equals upstream tariff proxy, excluding credit purchase fees; no inference about actual platform profit
model.quota: Reference quota debits are not cash receipts; procurement savings and customer entitlement loss can diverge without a revenue incentive.

limitations: Fixed registry cash scenario uses incumbent tariff as registry schedule; public list prices are procurement proxies, not invoices or marginal social costs.
